Examples are the constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) for Allen’s interval algebra and its fragments, and the CSPs for many other temporal rea- soning formalisms. Also in spatial reasoning, some of the earliest computational problems can be formulated as CSPs, e.g., the CSP for the region connection calculus.
